summary: Talen Energy Corp filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its acquisition of three natural gas power plants (Lawrenceburg 1,120 MW, Waterford 875 MW, Darby 456 MW) from Energy Capital Partners affiliates. The purchase price was $3.45 billion, consisting of ~$2.55 billion cash and 2,399,998 shares of common stock. The deal closed on June 15, 2026, with acquired entities expected to guarantee Talen's existing debt. No board recommendation or advisors are named in this excerpt. The acquisition was previously announced on January 15, 2026. Watch for integration execution and potential earnings accretion from the added 2,451 MW of gas-fired generation.
